high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "the_indian_crusader." The post features an ancient rock painting discovered at Bhimbetka rock shelters in Madhya Pradesh, India. The painting is dated to between 10,000 and 7000 BC. The main focus of the image is a rock painting depicting a human figure holding a leash attached to a dog. The human figure appears to be standing upright with one arm extended forward, holding the leash that is connected to the dog's collar. The dog is shown in profile, facing to the right, with its tail curled upwards
